analysis.summary: The role requires a hands-on commercial product manager to build and test a store-supplier promotion console, define campaign mechanics and spend controls, rigorously analyze placement and transaction data, and negotiate scope across cross-functional partners. The candidate brings extensive executive transformation and operational leadership experience, but lacks direct hands-on product discovery, ads monetization mechanics, and granular data analysis practice.
